_metadata.description: OT-P0-002 — guided section-by-section authoring with autofill and a structure-validation gate.

requirements.title: Guided section-by-section authoring with a structure-validation gate
requirements.description: The wizard walks the plan's sections in order, validates structure as it goes, accepts structured global and phase-scoped relevant context, and refuses to finalize while a mandatory section (or a phase's acceptance) is empty. The flow is followable by a small model with minimal context.

validation.notes: Structure-validation gate rejects empty mandatory sections and missing anchors.
Section-by-section progression exposes the next required section until complete.
Authoring stores global and phase-scoped relevant context and migrates legacy required-reading lines into structured context on finalize.
Relevant-context discovery persists curated batches and requires an applied batch decision or an honest no-context reason.
Author validate reports deterministic readiness quality findings before finalize.
Finalize blocks deterministic quality failures before persistence.
Disposition drop reasons preserve spaces, commas, semicolons, and punctuation.

requirements.title: Auto-fill the mechanical sections so the model only supplies prose
requirements.description: The wizard auto-fills deterministic setup where possible — boundary-derived regression-anchor intent, curated relevant-context batches (via prompt-manager/search-hub/cli-health), and curated code-reference batches (via search-hub/code locators) — degrading gracefully when a source is unavailable, so genuine prose and final context judgment are left for the agent.

validation.notes: Autofill fills mechanical sections when substrate seams are healthy.
Autofilled references round-trip through finalize into structured plan references.
Context discovery degrades honestly when the discovery seam is unavailable.
